meaning:
Lo-debar = "not a pasture"
a town in Manasseh in Gilead east of the Jordan
Also named: lid.vir (לִדְבִר "Debir" H1688B)

elsewhere.note: The king said to him, “Where is he?” Ziba said to the king, “Behold, he is in the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, in Lo Debar.”
you who rejoice in a thing of nothing, who say, ‘Haven’t we taken for ourselves horns by our own strength?’
